title: 第17章 贡献点第18章 开悟
content_zh:
“多谢马长老！今日马长老出手搭救之恩，晚辈铭记在心，还有王林执事，以后若有机会报偿，晚辈定不竭余力！”
林炎郑重的接过了那银色令牌，一脸感激。
“实际上以你的表现，就算是给你精英弟子也未尝不可，可你要知道木秀于林风必摧之的道理。有时候太光耀，并不一定是一件好事。”
“在外山，有一座天才修炼塔，一共有九层，闯过前三层可成为正式弟子，中三层可晋级优秀弟子，如果你能闯到上三层，则可晋级精英弟子。”
马保国提醒。
“晚辈明白！”
林炎瞬间心领神会。
马长老虽然不好直接给他精英弟子，可他如果实力达到了，去闯天才修炼塔，同样可以晋级精英弟子。
到时候就算宗门也不好说什么。
“好了，你可以拿着身份牌，去天才殿领取奖励了。”
“还有奖励？”
林炎诧异。
“当然，只要通过弟子考核，成为正式弟子的，都可以去天才殿领取一颗二品低级丹药。如果是正式弟子晋级优秀弟子，可以领取一颗二品中级丹药。如果是晋级精英弟子，则可领取一颗二品高级丹药。”
王林在一旁笑道。
“好！”
林炎点头，前往天才殿。
至于尹海，马保国也进行敲打：“你虽然有一个外山长老级的爷爷，可也不能胡作非为，这次看在尹龙那老东西的面子上不惩罚你，若有下次别怪老夫不讲情面！”
“是！”
尹海卑微的弯下腰去。
等马保国和王林走后，林雄方才如蒙大赦，他看向尹海：“那小子已经是外山优秀弟子了，看来未来我们想动他是有点难了……”

“哼！招惹了我尹海，我怎么可能饶恕他！就算是优秀弟子又怎样，只要还没成为精英弟子，我尹家还是可以灭杀他的！”
尹海眼神阴桀。
如果不是马保国出手，他估计已经被林炎杀死了，这笔账他又怎么可能善罢甘休。
……
天才殿内，天才络绎不绝。
“天龙剑宗不愧为沧澜域五大宗门之一。”
林炎发现天才殿内，有不少年轻一辈都比他强，在这里，气海境三重以内多如牛毛，几乎看不到养气境。
哪怕是气海境四重以上的，也都有不少。
他甚至看到有几个外貌格外好看的少年少女，实力居然达到了气海境七重。
这份实力，在青石城几大家族，都是族长级人物了，而在天龙剑宗却只是弟子级人物。
天龙剑宗随便一位外山长老，都是灵海境的修为。
“我要领取一份优秀弟子奖励。”
林炎来到窗口处，将身份牌交给了一个漂亮的师姐。
“养气九重的优秀弟子？”
那位漂亮师姐秀眉一挑，很是诧异。
林炎的境界实在是太低了，普通的外山正式弟子，都有气海修为。
而优秀弟子修为往往在气海六重之上。
她还是头一次遇到养气九重的优秀弟子，第一时间她脑海中就蹦出一个念头：“难不成是关系户？”
content_en:
"Thank you, Elder Ma! I will remember Elder Ma's kindness in rescuing me today. I will also remember Deacon Wang Lin. If I have the opportunity to repay you in the future, I will definitely spare no effort!"
Lin Yan solemnly took the silver token with a grateful look on his face.
"Actually, based on your performance, it's not a bad idea to be given to you as an elite disciple, but you have to know that anything as beautiful as Lin Feng will destroy it. Sometimes being too bright is not necessarily a good thing."
"There is a genius training tower in the outer mountain. It has nine floors. If you pass the first three floors, you can become a formal disciple. If you can pass the middle three floors, you can be promoted to an outstanding disciple. If you can pass the upper three floors, you can be promoted to an elite disciple."
Ma Baoguo reminded.
"Junior understands!"
Lin Yan understood instantly.
Although Elder Ma cannot directly give him an elite disciple, if he reaches the level of strength and goes to the genius training tower, he can also be promoted to an elite disciple.
Even the sect won't be able to say anything by then.
"Okay, you can take your identity card and go to the Genius Hall to receive your reward."
"Is there any reward?"
Lin Yan was surprised.
"Of course, as long as you pass the disciple assessment and become a formal disciple, you can go to the Genius Hall to receive a second-grade low-level elixir. If you are a formal disciple and advance to an outstanding disciple, you can receive a second-grade intermediate elixir. If you are an elite disciple, you can receive a second-grade high-level elixir."
Wang Lin laughed from the side.
"Okay!"
Lin Yan nodded and headed to the Genius Hall.
As for Yin Hai, Ma Baoguo also criticized him: "Although you have a grandfather who is an elder from outside the mountain, you can't act recklessly. This time I won't punish you for the sake of that old man Yin Long. If you do, don't blame me for being unkind next time!"
"Yes!"
Yin Hai bowed down humbly.
After Ma Baoguo and Wang Lin left, Lin Xiong just felt like he had been pardoned. He looked at Yin Hai: "That boy is already an outstanding disciple of Waishan. It seems that it will be difficult for us to touch him in the future..."
"Hmph! How can I forgive him for provoking me, Yin Hai! Even if he is an outstanding disciple, so long as he has not become an elite disciple, my Yin family can still kill him!"
Yin Hai's eyes were dark.
If Ma Baoguo hadn't taken action, he would have been killed by Lin Yan. How could he let go of this debt.
…
In the Hall of Geniuses, there is an endless stream of geniuses.
"The Tianlong Sword Sect is worthy of being one of the five major sects in the Canglan Region."
Lin Yan discovered that there were many younger people in the Genius Hall who were stronger than him. Here, there were so many people within the third level of the Qi Sea Realm, and there was almost no Qi Nourishing Realm.
There are many even those who are above the fourth level of Qi Sea Realm.
He even saw a few particularly good-looking boys and girls whose strength actually reached the seventh level of the Qi Sea Realm.
With this kind of strength, in several major families in Qingshi City, they are all patriarchal figures, but in the Tianlong Sword Sect, they are only disciple-level figures.
Any elder of the Tianlong Sword Sect from outside the mountain has a cultivation level in the Linghai realm.
"I want to receive a reward for outstanding disciples."
Lin Yan came to the window and handed his identity card to a beautiful senior sister.
"An outstanding disciple of the ninth level of Qi Yang?"
The beautiful senior sister raised her eyebrows in surprise.
Lin Yan's level is really too low. Ordinary formal disciples of Waishan have Qihai cultivation.
The cultivation of outstanding disciples is often above the sixth level of Qi Sea.
This was the first time she met an outstanding disciple of the ninth level of nourishing qi. The first thought popped into her mind: "Could it be that he is a related person?"
